profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer // Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
profile.summary:
As a Senior Product Manager at Microsoft, I leverage network administration background and customer focus to deliver innovative solutions for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Networking and Networking Integrations. I have over two years of experience in this role, and previously I was a Product Manager for Azure CLI, a command-line tool for managing Azure resources.

My passion is to learn and empower others through technology.As a Content Developer, I authored many topics covering multiple technologies and platforms, managed customer relations, and developed tools using PowerShell to automate and improve documentation and engineering processes. I enjoy finding solutions to problems and applying DevOps practices and Agile methodologies to develop large scale products that meet customer needs and expectations.

positions.description: Product Manager for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Networking and Networking Integrations.

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.locationName: Camp Pendleton, Ca; Camp Leatherneck, Afghanistan; Yuma, Az; Twentynine Palms Ca
positions.description:
Accountable for the installation, configuration, and management of voice/data network systems including hardware, software, and integration of multiple information systems. Evaluate and resolve customer information system problems, as well as conduct hardware and software upgrades.

Planned, implemented, and supervised the integration of multiple information systems in stand-alone and client-server environments allowing for over 20 internal organizations and four external agencies to remain connected, allowing uninterrupted global communication during worldwide conflicts.

Supervised helpdesk personnel during daily operating hours including training, ensuring customer satisfaction, and oversee timely delivery of quality technical support.

Led a team of seven to resolve client hardware and software issues involving equipment valued over $300,000, implementing a ticketing system to elevate problems beyond our scope of maintenance to senior technicians, Resulting in the correction of up to 150 requests a month.

positions.title: Boys Program Manager/Head Coach
positions.description:
Directed and supervised all Recreational Gymnastics and Competitive Team Gymnastics. Planned and scheduled program classes and competitions.
 
Developed and implemented training programs for over 100 athletes with varying levels of ability from novice to advanced.
 
Created safety and emergency response protocols and policies. Facilitated required quarterly training for eight staff members in the program, improving overall risk management and legal liability

Acted as a direct representative during national level conventions and networking functions for Summit Gymnastics Academy to build professional relationships throughout the gymnastics community, providing new opportunities for innovative training methods, business models, and marketing strategies.
